title: MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the 2026 UN Climate Change Conference in Antalya, Türkiye (COP31)
part_text: 107.Welcomes the agreement reached at the 83rd session of the Marine Environment Protection Committee(MEPC 83) of the International Maritime Organization (IMO) in April 2025, which established, for the first time, a global carbon pricing mechanism for international shipping through the IMO Net-Zero Framework, combining a GHG fuel standard with a pricing and reward mechanism; notes that the extraordinary MEPC session in October 2025 failed to formally adopt the IMO Net-Zero Framework;
